correctness.rationale: For the explicitly normalized positive C^{0,alpha} disk weight, angular Fourier orthogonality gives exact Gram bandwidth one and beta moments gamma_n=2epsilon B(2n+2,1+alpha+i tau). Monic Gram-Schmidt yields the exact 2-term polynomial recursion and h_n recurrence. Uniform comparison of the weight with constant 1 bounds the normalized monic norms; gamma-ratio gives first coefficient A n^{-alpha-i tau}, norm correction |A|^2 n^{-2alpha}/2. A contraction recurrence controls monic exterior ratios uniformly on |z|>=1 and gives an O(n^{-2alpha}) remainder. The nonzero limit and log-phase circle follow rigorously. verify.py independently tests finite Gram entries, orthogonality, beta quadrature, recurrence and asymptotic ratios; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating result establishes rates for all exponents strictly below Holder alpha, leaving the natural endpoint behavior unresolved. The explicit positive nonradial C^{0,alpha} weight forces a nonzero n^{-alpha} exterior correction while the orthonormal leading coefficient moves only at n^{-2alpha}. The exact Gamma amplitude and selectable logarithmic phase provide an interpretable sharpness/boundary-layer model, rather than an arbitrary coefficient computation or a routine reformulation. The construction separates angular cancellation in normalization from the pointwise exterior response and supplies reusable stress-test weights for proposed endpoint theorems.
